conditions: The select's entry evaluation completes normally and the expressions are operands of its communication cases.
limitations: Assignment targets in a receive clause are deferred to the selected receive case. The claim does not promise a communication can proceed.

triggers: Controlling edition erratum, correction, or material counterexample.

statement: In Go 1.23, entering a select evaluates all receive channel operands and all send channel and right-hand-side expressions exactly once in source order before case selection.
